title: Here’s Everything We Know About Taylor Swift & Travis Kelce’s Wedding So Far
summary: From the size of the guest list to when they may tie the not, here's what we can expect from Tayvis' big day.
contentText:
When Taylor Swif t and Travis Kelce announced their engagement with a simple Instagram post in August 2025, it broke the internet.

And in the time since, the superstar couple have only continued to turn heads. Swift released her 15th Billboard 200 No. 1 album, The Life of a Showgirl , that October — moving a record-breaking 4 million equivalent album units in its first week — while Kelce signed on for his 14th season with the Kansas City Chiefs the following April.

Related

A Timeline of Taylor Swift & Travis Kelce’s Relationship

Members of the Tayvis camp have also kept what they may or may not know about the couple’s plans mostly quiet. Kelce’s mother, Donna Kelce , straight up refused to speak about her potential involvement with the wedding planning when approached by a photographer at LAX. “I’m just happy. I’m so happy for them,” Donna said at the time.

Swift’s future sister-in-law, Kylie Kelce (who’s married to Trav’s big brother, Jason) even made a plea on her Not Gonna Lie podcast in April for people to stop asking her for wedding dirt. “Quit asking me and my mother-in-law about upcoming nuptials,” she said point-blank to the camera. “Nobody’s f–king telling you anything.” She added: “I don’t have any details. I have no details. I have none. Look at that. That’s how many details I have. None. None.”

But while Donna and Kylie are staying hush-hush, a few people close to the duo — as well as Swift and Kelce themselves — have shared bits and pieces here and there about the nuptials. And as their reported wedding weekend draws closer, Billboard is breaking down all the details we do have about the big day.

Here is everything we know (so far) about the Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce wedding.
